description: This source file implements utility functions for extracting files and contents from archive files (e.g., tar files) within the Android Cuttlefish project. It provides functions to extract specific files or all contents from an archive, extract archives to memory, and list archive contents, utilizing the bsdtar command-line tool.

methods.name: Result<std::vector<std::string>> ExtractHelper(std::vector<std::string> & files,const std::string & archive_filepath,const std::string & target_directory,const bool keep_archive)
methods.description: Helper function that processes a list of files extracted from an archive, cleans up directory paths, and optionally deletes the archive file.

methods.name: Result<std::vector<std::string>> ExtractFiles(const std::string & archive,const std::vector<std::string> & to_extract,const std::string & target_directory)
methods.description: Extract specified files from an archive to a target directory using bsdtar.

methods.name: Result<std::vector<std::string>> ExtractAll(const std::string & archive,const std::string & target_directory)
methods.description: Extract all contents of an archive to a target directory.

methods.name: Result<std::vector<std::string>> ExtractImages(const std::string & archive_filepath,const std::string & target_directory,const std::vector<std::string> & images,const bool keep_archive)
methods.description: Extract specific images (files) from an archive to a target directory.

methods.name: Result<std::string> ExtractImage(const std::string & archive_filepath,const std::string & target_directory,const std::string & image,const bool keep_archive)
methods.description: Extract a single image (file) from an archive and return its path.

methods.name: Result<std::vector<std::string>> ExtractArchiveContents(const std::string & archive_filepath,const std::string & target_directory,const bool keep_archive)
methods.description: Extract all contents of an archive to a directory and process the files list.

methods.name: std::string ExtractArchiveToMemory(const std::string & archive_filepath,const std::string & archive_member)
methods.description: Extract a single member from an archive directly into memory.

methods.description: List all contents of an archive.
